policy: Use the supplied two-atom 3D MOL coordinates and explicit total charge. No known SMILES graph,generated conformer or force-field relaxation is an input. After perception,inspect the returned bond graph and audit radical assignment on that actual resulting graph. Atom order is the supplied C then O.
scope: A deterministic coordinate-to-graph model with formal charges,not measured partial charges,oxidation states or a uniquely proven experimental bond model.
